messages:
sara_ops: Heads up — 6x H100 replacements from vendor arrived FRA but flagged by customs for 'incomplete paperwork'. vendor_ops says RMA AWB on hold. Need decision: expedite re-clearance vs reship direct from vendor.

vendor_ops: Sorry — forwarder hit an HS/code mismatch. We submitted corrected invoice at 09:12 CET. Customs flagged because some SKUs rolled under legacy tariff. AWB: 341-EX1234567.

oliver_logistics: Can we get a copy of the corrected manifest and commercial invoice? customs_broker needs HS 8443.32 explicit line for the H100 assemblies.

vendor_ops: attaching manifest snippet (pasted):
```
ITEM|SKU|QTY|HS|DECLARED_VALUE
1|H100-X1|6|8443.32|USD 22000
```

claudia_pm: If customs release takes >24h we need to swap allocations. EU infra has low spare capacity this week. matt_infra — can Dedicated pool absorb 6 GPUs for prod fallback?

matt_infra: We have 4 spare from DE cluster and 2 from US-East Dedicated (cross-region move would cost ~1.5x). We can hot-reassign but need approval for cross-region latency impact for some customers.

jen_sre: If we shift 2 from US-East, we should update routing policy to prefer EU-hosted models for low-latency customers. I can push a canary policy change. Minimal infra work.

claudia_pm: OK do that if release >12h. Meanwhile, vendor_ops — what are options to clear faster? Air courier expedite? Reship?

vendor_ops: Two options: 1) pay expedited broker fee and provide corrected docs = ETA clearance ~6-12h (cost ~€1.2k + duties), 2) recall & reship from vendor warehouse (ETA 48-72h) but avoids customs back-and-forth. We can also split (send 2 expedited, hold 4).

oliver_logistics: Split sounds best. Send 2 expedited to unblock urgent pipelines, keep 4 to be reworked if needed. Who signs expense for broker? finance approval required.

claudia_pm: Finance said emergency shipping & broker are covered under procurement contingency up to €2k per incident. OK to authorize up to €1.5k. Proceed with split expedited.

vendor_ops: Roger. We'll push 2 units through the broker today. Sending AWB for expedited pair soon. Remaining 4 will remain on hold pending rework instructions.

matt_infra: For the 2 expedited, what's the expected slot time to be available in EU pool? Need to know to reassign jobs.

vendor_ops: Expedited AWB: 341-EX1237890 — ETD FRA 14:40 CET, inbound to our DC by 18:00 CET, handoff to Redwood staging ETA 20:00 CET local.

jen_sre: Perfect. I'll create a temporary routing override to move low-latency traffic to those 2 once they register. Also will add telemetry to watch 99th pct spikes.

claudia_pm: Oliver — please coordinate with on-site staging for serial audits and firmware checks. Last week we had 1 unit with firmware mismatch; that will block auto-join.

oliver_logistics: Noted. staging checklist: verify serials, run `rtr-verify --serial <S>` and confirm firmware >= 2.4.1. If mismatch, vendor_ops to push image or we escalate RMA.

vendor_ops: We'll pre-stage firmware images and a recovery USB. If a unit fails firmware check, we can swap under warranty but that adds ~24h.

claudia_pm: Also, record cost breakdown in the thread for postmortem: broker_fee, duties, expedited_label, labor hours. We'll want to reclaim if vendor liability.

vendor_ops: Understood. We'll log expenses under PO# PROD-RMA-5521 and mark vendor responsibility if paperwork error is confirmed.

matt_infra: One last ask — if the remaining 4 are delayed >48h, we should provision loaner GPUs from US-East pool until replacements arrive. That will be slightly higher cost but keeps SLOs.

claudia_pm: Agreed. Jen, coordinate canary DR policy, Oliver — staging ready. Vendor, send AWB and confirmation when 2 units released.

vendor_ops: AWB for expedited pair sent to oliver_logistics and customs_bot. We'll follow up with the release number.

customs_bot: SYSTEM: Release update expected within 3 hours if corrected paperwork accepted.

sara_ops: Thanks everyone — please post final AWB and serials when available. I'll update the infra incident ticket with the fallback plan. :thumbsup:
